The current Cloud Connected on-premises task separates Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+, Cloud Connect 2.0 and assistant, investigation and connector permissions. SAIA-9918 still describes 2.2.0 through 2.3.6 as unsupported for Cloud Connected and 2.4.0 as planned. The exact November 4 GA text was present. Original October Controlled Availability and historical Triage wording were unavailable. Both English registry paths redirect officially to the current compatibility and Triage/Response guides. The standalone Cloud Connect task still returns HTTP 404, while the November 4 GA release text is available. The exact October Controlled Availability and original Triage wording remain unrecovered. The complete ES 8.8 AWS tables put Calgary, Stockholm and both GovCloud exceptions for the assistant and Agentic SOC in Essentials. Premier names Calgary and GovCloud exceptions and its Montréal row has no exception listed. Cloud Connect names a Montréal exception for the assistant and none for Calgary. Its table does not establish a per-agent rollout or GovCloud availability. The separate GCP and Azure table limits components to ES and SOAR and excludes SOAR in GCP US West.
